critical.issue: FIXED: Routes defined after app.include_router(api_router) at line 4916 were not being registered. Moved include_router to end of file.

BusinessSettings.js has no bank refund section (correct)
AuthCallback.js role routing logic is correct: admin→/admin, creator→/creator-dashboard, business→/dashboard
